frontier.gap: Current dependency closure is graph-theoretic only; Bayesian conditional independence and Fristonian dynamical blankets remain deliberately distinct and unproved.

frontier.surface: Constitutional significance of dependency topology change

frontier.gap: Exterior coverage currently emphasizes one-coordinate minimal pairs plus enum probes; interactions among multiple simultaneous boundary changes are not exhaustively covered.

frontier.gap: Assumption countermodels currently line the two hypotheses of PreservesPredicate.comp, not every hypothesis of every theorem in the formal inventory.

frontier.gap: The trusted core assumes supplied ActionIntent features are accurate; extraction of those features from natural language remains outside the verified surface.
